name: trucker-heaven
description: Trucker Heaven monorepo: shared API (api/) plus the parking, rentals and food modules

scripts.migrate: npm run migrate --prefix parking/backend && npm run migrate --prefix rentals/backend && npm run migrate --prefix food/backend
scripts.check: node --check api/server.js && npm run check --prefix parking/backend && npm run check --prefix rentals/backend && npm run check --prefix food/backend
scripts.test: node --test api/test/*.test.js && npm test --prefix parking/backend && npm test --prefix rentals/backend && npm run test:unit --prefix food/backend
